transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I guess… I’ve been having some trouble explaining things clearly at work. I’m a supervisor, so I have to talk about inventory numbers and the weekend schedule, and lately my words kind of… jump around. Like I’ll start with the truck delivery, then somehow I’m on Thursday, then the church grill, then my boss’s tone of voice, and people just look at me like they can’t follow.

I don’t mean to make it sound dramatic. I’m usually pretty good at my job. But it’s been happening enough that I thought maybe I should come in and ask about it.
Have you been feeling unusually energetic lately?

Um… unusually energetic? I don’t think so, no. I mean, I try to keep up with work and everything, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been running on extra energy or anything like that. At least, not that I’ve noticed. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you been feeling unusually cheerful or high lately?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I have good moments like anybody, but not unusually cheerful or… high, I guess. Nothing that stands out to me that way. Is that an okay way to put it?
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, not voices like someone talking when nobody’s there. Sometimes I’ll think I heard something and then it’s just the building or people outside, but nothing I’d call voices. Does that make sense?
Have you been feeling more important or more powerful than usual?

More important or powerful? No, I don’t think so. I mean, I try to do my job well and be responsible, but I wouldn’t say I feel… above anyone or especially powerful or anything. Nothing like that that I’ve noticed. Is that what you mean?
Have you been convinced of something that other people say isn’t true?

I don’t think so… I mean, I have opinions, sure, and sometimes I may stick with them, but not something where everyone’s telling me it’s not true and I’m just convinced anyway. At least, nothing comes to mind. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking?
Have you had any episodes where you lost track of time and couldn’t remember what happened?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I might lose track of time if I’m busy or tired, like anyone, but not where I come to and can’t remember what happened. Nothing like that stands out to me. Is that what you mean?
Have you been needing less sleep than usual?

Needing less sleep? No, I wouldn’t say that. If anything, I try to keep a pretty normal schedule. I might have a rough night here or there, but I haven’t felt like I suddenly don’t need sleep or anything like that. Does that answer what you’re looking for?
When your words jump from one topic to another, does it feel like the ideas are connected in your mind even if other people can’t follow?

Yeah… I think so. It’s embarrassing, because in my head it does feel connected. Like at work, I’ll be trying to explain inventory numbers or the weekend schedule, and somehow I’ll jump from the trucks to Thursday, then to the church grill, then something about my boss’s tone… and I can see people looking at me like they’ve lost the thread.

I don’t mean to do it. It makes sense to me while I’m saying it, at least at first. But I guess other people can’t always follow. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have people told you that the actual words or phrases you use seem odd or made-up, even apart from your jumping between topics?

Not really, no. I mean, nobody’s told me I’m making up words or anything like that. They might say I’m hard to follow sometimes, but I think that’s more about how I’m explaining things, not the actual words themselves. At least… I haven’t noticed people reacting like the words are strange. Does that make sense?
Have you had any recent headaches?
Headaches? Um… not that I can really say. I mean, maybe the normal little kind if I’m tired or stressed, but nothing recent that stood out to me. I haven’t been keeping track, though—should I be?
Have you felt that ordinary things around you were sending you special messages meant just for you?

I don’t think so… not like, messages meant just for me. I mean, sometimes I’ll notice things and wonder if there’s a reason, but I think everybody does that a little, right?

I haven’t really had ordinary things—like TV or signs or whatever—sending me special messages. At least not that I can say clearly. Is that what you mean?
Have you been feeling unusually irritable lately?

I don’t think unusually irritable, no. I mean, I can get a little short if I’m tired or if something’s frustrating, but I wouldn’t say it’s been out of character or anything. At least, I haven’t noticed people saying I’m snapping at them. Does that sound like what you’re asking?
Have you found yourself feeling much less motivated to do everyday things than usual?

I wouldn’t say much less, no. I mean, some days I’m slower getting started with chores or errands, but I usually still get to things. I don’t think it’s been a big change from usual… unless I’m not noticing it. Is that the kind of motivation you mean?
Did this problem with your speech come on suddenly?

No, I don’t think it came on all at once. It’s been more gradual, I guess. People at work started noticing my explanations getting kind of tangled, or I’d stop in the middle of talking on the sales floor… maybe about six months ago. I didn’t think it was that bad at first, but it’s been there a while. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you been having more trouble than usual keeping up with your work or other everyday responsibilities?

A little, yes… I mean, I’m still trying to keep up, but work has been harder. They don’t really let me run the busy weekend shifts anymore, which is embarrassing to say. And after my last review, my boss said if things don’t improve I could be suspended.

At home it’s not like I’m doing nothing, but my wife has had to pick up some commitments I used to handle, because people were getting… I guess confused or uncomfortable around me. I’m trying not to make it sound worse than it is, but yes, it has affected things.
Have you had any seizures?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, not that I’m aware of. I’ve never had anything where someone said, “That looked like a seizure,” if that’s what you mean.
During the past six months, have you had a period when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

I don’t think so, no. I mean, I’ve had down days, and I’ve been frustrated with how things are going, but I wouldn’t say I was depressed most of the day almost every day for two weeks. At least, not that I’ve noticed. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Before these speech problems started, did you have any head injury?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I can’t remember any head injury before the speech stuff started. Nothing major, anyway… unless you mean something really small? But no, nothing that stands out.
Has a doctor told you that you have any brain or nerve condition?
No, not that I know of. I mean, no doctor has told me I have a brain or nerve condition. If they did, I think I would remember that… so I’d say no.
